The candidate covers exactly the five declared propositions, one predicate each, names matching identifiers, each taking only `env`, all single-expression bodies with one `return` and no assignments, disallowed builtins, sibling calls, or mutation. `key_found` correctly implements the declared latch: it returns true when the previous valuation was true (guarded so the first step falls through) or when the current 7x7 view shows a key via `cell[0] == 5`, which matches the documented channel encoding and the stated semantics that an already-in-view key counts at step one. `has_matching_key` reads only `env.carrying` and the grid: it requires carrying a key whose color equals the color of the door found at the locked door's documented place (column `env.width - env.room_size` over the target room's row span derived from the ball's row via `y // (env.room_size - 1)`), exactly the place-based lookup the layout rules prescribe, and it reverts when the key is dropped since it reads current carry state. `target_door_open` reads `is_open` of that same place-located door each step, so it can turn false again when the door is toggled shut, and it correctly ignores `is_locked`. `target_room_entered` is the declared latch: previous valuation or the agent standing within the target room's square block (x >= width - room_size and y inside the ball-derived room span), which includes the doorway cell as required, and it stays true after the agent leaves. `target_picked_up` requires carrying a ball whose color matches the mission string built as 'pick up the <color> ball', consistent with the documented mission format and the guarantee that the target is always the unique ball. All grid and cell scans guard `None` before attribute reads, only documented API surfaces (`env.mission`, `env.agent_pos`, `env.grid.get`, `env.width`, `env.room_size`, `env.carrying`, `env.gen_obs()[image]`, `env.episode_memory[previous_valuation]`, door `is_open`, object `type`/`color`) are used, no NumPy methods are called, no invented attributes or RM/description/reward references appear, and the ball-row fallback keeps the door scans well-defined on the final carrying step.
